results.requirement: Exact candidate, parent, tree, remote branch, package subtree, unchanged root app, patch encoding and package output rows are bound to raw Git.
The candidate patch applies to the pinned accepted base; the 25 source replacements match the replay and the changes stay within the 26-path frozen allowlist.

Frozen review DTO shapes are preserved: approvalAudit.eventId, the four-field PrivateDraftReview shape, generic project/site ReviewCheck scope and string ID, and strict rejection of unallocated fields.
Healthy publish and rollback refreshes consume activePublication and update review/publication identity without reload.
A requested absent private draft returns 404 and reaches the page not-found path without rendering draft content.
Authorized stale-save 409 includes current draft identity/content without writes; unauthorized callers get no content and the losing editor retains its buffer.

Draft media renders only for the exact canonical relative owner-preview URL; absolute, origin-relative, raw slash, case-altered/double encoding, query, fragment, trailing slash and traversal inputs are rejected.
New section, paragraph, list, code and link inputs are empty; no fabricated link URL/check date is added; evidence starts unknown/null.
Focused unit and integration checks pass on an isolated exact-base replay.
Packaged unit/integration/lint/typecheck receipts and build/browser bindings match raw candidate package bytes.
Fresh parent build and fresh parent browser execution.
